title: Third Treaty of Prairie du Chien
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Third Treaty of Prairie du Chien", at revision 1376052683, opens: "The Treaty of Prairie du Chien may refer to any of several treaties made and signed in Prairie du Chien, Wisconsin between the United States, representatives from the Sioux, Sac and Fox, Menominee, Ioway, Winnebago and the Anishinaabeg Native American peoples." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q27989231, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1829 treaty between the United States and the Ho-Chunk". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
